The '''Coffee Maker''' is a piece of equipment that automatically brews a single cup of [[Coffee]] in the morning. It is received in the mail after completing [[Evelyn]]'s [[Quests#Gifts for George|"Gifts for George"]] Special Order.

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
